import json
from itertools import product

d=json.loads(context)
qs=d['quotes']; skus=d['skus']; vendors={v['id']:v for v in d['vendors']}
opts=[]
for s,info in skus.items():
    opts.append([q for q in qs if q['sku']==s and q['quality']=='approved' and q['units']>=info['demand'] and q['units']<=info['demand']+2 and q['arrival']<=info['deadline']])
best=None
for combo in product(*opts):
    bysku={q['sku']:q for q in combo}
    if any(q['needs_same_vendor_sku'] and bysku[q['needs_same_vendor_sku']]['vendor']!=q['vendor'] for q in combo): continue
    carbon=sum(q['carbon'] for q in combo)
    if carbon>d['carbon_cap']: continue
    groups={}
    for q in combo: groups.setdefault(q['vendor'],[]).append(q)
    if len(groups)<3: continue
    total=0; valid=True
    for vid,items in groups.items():
        v=vendors[vid]; units=sum(q['units'] for q in items)
        if units>v['unit_cap']: valid=False; break
        gross=sum(q['units']*q['unit_cents'] for q in items)
        # exact half-up rounding of gross * (10000-tier_bps) / 10000
        numerator=gross*(10000-v['tier_bps'])
        merch=(numerator+5000)//10000 if units>=v['tier_units'] else gross
        cost=merch+(0 if gross>=v['free_shipping_gross'] else v['shipping_cents'])
        if len({q['sku'] for q in items})>=2 and merch>=v['rebate_merchandise_min']: cost-=v['rebate_cents']
        total+=cost
    if valid and (best is None or total<best): best=total
print(FINAL(str(best)))
